handoff_note: Moved from data/rules/rates.v1.json on 2026-10-29 by ADR-0007. Reference for the Buwiz Forms / BIR mini app owner. Books code does not load this file; rates, thresholds, the graduated table, OSD, rounding and due dates are Forms-owned.

units.money: decimal text with exactly two places in JSON (for example "200000.00"); Books stores integer centavos internally

citations: verify.md s2 #35: window hard-coded in Books percentage-tax.ts:65-68
verify.md s2 #62 (RMC 69-2023; RA 11534 proviso ends 30 Jun 2023)
pt_rate_rows.notes: Current 3% rate. Q3 2026 uses this row (300 bps).

citations: respicio.ph commentary only (verify.md s2 #63; bir.md PT-2 and s4 do not confirm)
pt_rate_rows.notes: Claimed extension of the 1% rate. No enacting law was found. Stored disputed and OFF. Books warns for 2023-07-01 to 2025-12-31 periods (decision D6). Q3 2026 is unaffected.

pt_rate_lookup: Use the rate row whose window contains the filing period's effective date. Windows apply to the filing period, not the transaction date (PROPOSAL, consistent with the period rules).

vat_threshold.test: posted sales year-to-date strictly greater than the threshold blocks the 8% option and forces VAT status
citations: RA 11976 text, threshold 'three million pesos' (verify.md s2 #65; bir.md PT-7)
Books percentage-tax.ts:50 and vat.ts:70 (defined twice; do not port)
vat_threshold.cpi_adjustment: UNKNOWN: the statute says the amount is CPI-adjusted every three years; no adjusted figure found (bir.md PT-7). Keep it as a dated fact, not a constant.

eight_percent.base: gross sales/receipts plus other non-operating income, minus the reduction, floored at zero
eight_percent.reduction_applies_only_to: purely self-employed or professional individuals without compensation income
eight_percent.books_gap: Books omits other non-operating income from the base (verify.md s2 #36, CONFIRMED).

osd.base: net sales (IV.7 = IV.5 - IV.6) per Part IV item 11 wording
osd.status_detail: Code (form_1701a.rs:470-471) and the 1701-MS field tab use 40% of net sales. Printed Part I item 17 reads '40% of gross sales' (bir.md s2). The conflict needs review.

rounding.money_internal: integer centavos; no rounding until the form line
rounding.half_rule: round half away from zero, applied once at output (decision D7; PROPOSAL)

pt_example.note: Python round() is banker's rounding and would give 0.04; the golden test must assert half-away explicitly.

whole_peso_1701ms.status_detail: The printed 49-centavo rule is listed as image-only (verify.md s2 #83). Do not apply until the printed form is re-read.

2551Q.rule: 25 days after the end of the calendar quarter
citations: RA 11976 s128(1) (verify.md s2 #64; bir.md PT-3, D-1)

1701Q.rule: Q1 15 May, Q2 15 August, Q3 15 November of the taxable year

1601C.rule: 10th day of the following month; December withholding due 15 January; eFPS group days A15/B14/C13/D12/E11
1601C.status_detail: Code (books.md s4a, form-1601c.ts:178-199) is CONFIRMED; printed due-date text is UNCONFIRMED (verify.md s2 #83, bir.md D-3).

1701MS.rule: 15 April of the year after the taxable year; second installment of 50% or less, due 15 October (form item 26)
1701MS.status_detail: April 15 is CONFIRMED (bir.md M-9, RMC 34-2025 Annex A). The 15 October installment is UNCONFIRMED (verify.md s2 #83). The TY2025 deadline was extended to 15 May 2026 (RMC 30-2026, not read).
